status: proposed license entries; comment template requires an approved-notice permalink before packaging
permalinkRule: After approved notice bytes are committed to jmlx-native-macos-arm64/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES, replace this token in a later implementation commit with https://github.com/Alipsa/jmlx/blob/<full earlier notice commit SHA>/jmlx-native-macos-arm64/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES. Preserve that commit through a merge commit, require reviewed-main/candidate ancestry and compare the linked Juffa section raw bytes with the local and packaged sections. Record the literal final comment and its hash for review.

licenses.name: MIT License
licenses.comments: Applies to the jmlx native artifact code, mlx-c, Apple/MLX contributions covered by their existing MIT grants, and the other MIT components listed in META-INF/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES, including nlohmann/json, fmt, gguf-tools, FP16 and supervised-lda. MIT notices are also retained there for the opt_einsum algorithm attribution and VkFFT algorithm reference. The reviewed Juffa expression has separately identified CC BY-SA 4.0 terms.

licenses.name: Apache License, Version 2.0
licenses.comments: Applies to Apache-2.0 components identified in META-INF/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES, including vendored metal-cpp compiled into libmlx.dylib and the NVIDIA/Filipe RNC Maia cexpf and TensorFlow adaptations. An Apache-2.0 notice is also retained there for the JAX Threefry algorithm reference.

licenses.name: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
licenses.comments: Applies to Norbert Juffa's covered expression in the reviewed Metal erf and Metal/CPU SIMD erfinv material, including corresponding compiled forms in libmlx.dylib and mlx.metallib. Apple/MLX contributions rely separately on existing MIT grants. No CC adapter's license is identified. See <{{APPROVED_NOTICE_PERMALINK}}> (scope and redistribution basis), also packaged in META-INF/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES. The complete CC license is packaged in META-INF/LICENSE-CC-BY-SA-4.0.

licenses.name: BSD 2-Clause License
licenses.comments: Applies to BSD-2-Clause material identified in META-INF/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES, including Norbert Juffa expm1f.

licenses.name: BSD 3-Clause License
licenses.comments: Applies to BSD-3-Clause components identified in META-INF/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES, including pocketfft, V8, NumPy, fastermath and PyTorch (including Metal hypot). BSD-3-Clause notices are also retained there for the Random123 Threefry attribution and CUB merge-sort algorithm reference.

licenses.name: zlib License
